We need to produce a tool call. Use apply_template. Provide product SMILES as guessed. Let's do that.
<thought>We need to apply the retrosynthetic template with ID 1914395 to the product molecule described in the mapped reaction. The product SMILES (without atom mapping) is derived from the mapped SMILES: [F:1][CH:2]1[CH2:3][N:4]([CH2:5][c:6]2[cH:7][cH:8][cH:9][cH:10][cH:11]2)[CH2:12]1. Removing the mapping gives the SMILES string “FC1CH2N(CH2c2ccccc2)CH2C1”. We will use the apply_template tool with this SMILES and template_id 1914395 to obtain all possible precursor combinations.
Now tool call.
